name: Visily
summary: Visily is an AI-powered wireframing tool that helps non-designers create beautiful app wireframes from simple sketches, screenshots, or text prompts. It speeds up the ideation process and allows teams to collaborate effortlessly on low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes.
description: Visily is an AI-powered wireframing tool that helps non-designers create beautiful app wireframes from simple sketches, screenshots, or text prompts. It speeds up the ideation process and allows teams to collaborate effortlessly on low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes. Visily is the UI design software anyone can use. With Visily, you can create hi-fidelity wireframes and prototypes in minutes, all with no learning curve. AI Wireframe Generation: Turn sketches or text into wireframes. Component Library: Access a wide variety of UI components. Collaboration: Real-time team editing and commenting. Template Gallery: Start quickly with prebuilt layouts.
